name: Tamarac
intro: Tamarac was built around its golf courses and its retirement communities, and its food service reflects both: club dining rooms that feed members lunch off the back nine, and large senior-living campuses whose kitchens plate hundreds of covers three times a day, every day, on a dietician's menu cycle. Along Commercial Boulevard and University Drive, neighborhood diners and family restaurants round out the scene.

Senior dining is unforgiving about consistency — same spec, same case, same window — and that is what scheduled institutional programs are for. Club kitchens want the opposite: split cases and specialty items that keep a member menu from going stale. We run both from Pompano Beach, about fifteen minutes east, on the same 7-day refrigerated routes.
route_note: About 15 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse — Commercial Boulevard and club stops land early on the northwest Broward run.

faqs_unique.q: Can you supply senior community dining services in Tamarac?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. We run scheduled case programs with consistent specs, reliable windows, and volumes that follow your census and menu cycle.

faqs_unique.q: Do you deliver to golf club kitchens in Tamarac?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Club dining rooms get standing orders for staples plus split cases for member events, banquets, and seasonal menus.

cta_text: Tell us your club covers, facility census, or neighborhood dining volume — we will set a Tamarac produce program that holds its spec.
